estimates.assumptions: 5 medium russet potatoes (~200g each, total 1000g raw, skin-on wedges); ~550 kcal from starch
1 large head broccoli (~600g raw with stem); florets cut into bite-size pieces, roasted
2 cloves garlic (~6g total), used split between broccoli oil and sauce
2 boneless skinless chicken breasts (~250g each raw, total 500g); pan-cooked, no added fat in estimate
3 tbsp balsamic vinegar (~45ml total for 2 servings, inferred from typical glaze volume in step 5)
2 tbsp honey (~40g total for 2 servings, inferred from typical glaze volume in step 5)
1 tsp chicken stock concentrate/bouillon (~5g total for 2 servings, plus 1/4 cup water per instructions)
1 tbsp butter (~14g), stirred into finished glaze
1 tbsp vegetable oil (~14g), used for pan-frying chicken (all oil accounted as consumed)
1 tbsp olive oil (~14g), used in garlic-oil microwave step for broccoli (all oil accounted as consumed)
